subtitle: A store for app repositories
description:
The store you're looking at. It lists every app in a repository of Holm apps, gives each one its own page with screenshots, a description and the prompt that built it, and installs it on your node from a Get button.

It reads the repository's index.json, the same file a node reads from a repository it trusts. Point it at your own repository to give your apps a store of their own.
whatsNew: Now a store: a front page of every app, a page for each one, and a Get button that opens an install sheet written for your node.
